observations.source: Controller of Budget, County Governments Budget Implementation Review Report FY 2024/25, section 3.38 (Siaya)
observations.note: The report states total own-source revenue collection of KSh 436 million: KSh 199 million Facility Improvement Financing and KSh 236 million from other sources. Press reports give 436.68 million. Read from OCR text of the PDF, so check the exact figure in the printed table.

observations.source: Siaya County Secretary statement, as reported by K24 Digital
observations.note: Other statements say the county raised over KSh 900 million. The county's own document has not been read, so what it counts is unknown.

target.source: Controller of Budget, County Governments Budget Implementation Review Report FY 2024/25, section 3.38 (Siaya)
target.description: Budgeted own-source revenue of about KSh 1.04 billion: KSh 643 million to be deposited into the County Revenue Fund and KSh 400 million as Appropriations-in-Aid spent at source.
target.note: The report states a performance of 47 per cent for Siaya. 436 of 1,043 is 42 per cent, so the report measures the target differently. That difference is not resolved.

budget.source: Controller of Budget, County Governments Budget Implementation Review Report FY 2024/25, section 3.38 (Siaya)
budget.note: Figures read from the OCR text of the PDF and checked against each other (2.76 of 4.87 is 57 per cent; 4.99 of 6.02 is 83 per cent). Check exact values in the printed tables.

pending_bills.note: The county reported KSh 1.12 billion pending at 30 June 2024 and settled KSh 577.7 million during FY 2024/25. The closing balance at 30 June 2025 could not be read reliably from the OCR text and is not shown.

stalled_projects.note: The county reported nine stalled development projects as of 30 June 2025. The project list in the PDF could not be read reliably, so individual projects are not shown.

audit.source: Report of the Auditor-General on County Executive of Siaya for the Year Ended 30 June, 2024

findings.label: Pending bills unsettled at time of audit
findings.note: Some bills date from 2015 to 2023. The Auditor-General noted this as an emphasis matter and said the opinion is not modified for it.

findings.label: Compensation of employees (Statement of receipts and payments)
findings.note: KSh 14,509,755 was paid to 240 staff in June 2024 outside the payroll database (IPPD). This is part of the basis for the qualified opinion.

findings.label: Projected own-source revenue in the FY 2023/24 budget
findings.note: Out of projected revenues of KSh 9,761,123,387 in total.
